title: Dry-Run Apply, Validation, Transactional Activation & Rollback Receipt
objective: Before a pack/component becomes active, calculate the dependency/apply plan, validate references/rights/compatibility, show conflicts, and support atomic activation or rollback. Produce a deterministic receipt listing activated components, versions, dependencies, extensions and failures without bypassing existing owner-domain validation.

scope.purpose: Provide dry-run dependency/apply planning, pre-activation validation, atomic activation/rollback semantics and deterministic receipts without bypassing existing owner authorities.
scope.completion_gate: A representative pack/component activation can be dry-run deterministically, fails closed on invalid references/rights/compatibility/conflicts, commits atomically only through existing owner validation paths, rolls back atomically on failure, and emits a deterministic receipt covering components, versions, dependencies, extensions and failures.

selection_boundaries: CNI-11 creates no canonical owner-domain state authority.
CNI-02 remains dependency/compatibility authority; CNI-11 consumes its deterministic result rather than replacing it.
CNI-09 remains cross-pack extension/conflict-analysis authority; CNI-11 consumes its deterministic result rather than replacing it.
ARI-11 remains resource rights/use-capability authority; Action/Event and owner domains retain canonical validation and mutation authority.
CNI-11 creates no hidden activation ledger, parallel owner state, inferred rights or silent partial activation.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after CNI-11 completion and selects the newly eligible MAS interstitial before the program-local CNI-12 successor.
CNI-12, PCA, MAS-02+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: CNI-11 is closed. MAS-01 is selected_not_started by OPS3 after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start; CNI-12 remains planned and unselected.
